scope: Executed cross-file arithmetic and provenance checks on published GitHub audit JSON, not raw SHP/DEM/ZIP or feature-level geometry

theory.interpretation: The maximum distance from one endpoint to its rounded grid center is half a cell diagonal, whereas the maximum spread between two source endpoints assigned to one cell is a full cell diagonal. A >10cm pair spread can be geometrically possible without exceeding the individual endpoint drift bound; this does not validate the join.
